tagline: A river-to-river grid of colonial lanes, leafy squares and BYOB dining rooms, in the city where the nation was founded.

events.name: Mummers Parade
events.desc: String bands, comic brigades and feathered costumes parade on New Year's Day in a tradition that goes back more than a century.

events.name: Philadelphia Flower Show
events.desc: One of the world's longest-running horticultural shows, usually held in the Pennsylvania Convention Center.

events.name: Welcome America
events.desc: A multi-day Independence Day festival of free events that builds to a concert and fireworks on the Parkway.

events.name: Philadelphia Marathon
events.desc: A weekend of races that starts and finishes on the Parkway near the art museum.
